verdict.rationale: AngelList documents exporting many cap table reports to Excel and an Open Cap Table Format (OCF) export of the cap table, which covers the core of open-format cap table portability. It also documents helping users move to other cap table providers. However, nothing shows that the full transaction history (transfers, exercises, repurchases, conversions, terminations) can be exported as a complete ledger to Excel/CSV. Missing for 10: documented export of the full transaction history/ledger, explicit CSV format support, independent or hands-on corroboration of complete export.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can export my complete cap table and full transaction history to open formats (Excel/CSV) at any time — my ownership data is never held hostage

citations.quote: AngelList Equity offers many reports available for export to Excel from your cap table.
Open Cap Table Format (OCT): An OCF format export of your cap table.
we've made it easy for them to transition to other cap table software providers, including J.P. Morgan and Pulley
